in_hebrew.name: Richart
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Ruler of the people
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Richart הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Germanic elements rīch, meaning 'ruler' and hart, meaning 'people'. Richart was a common name in medieval Europe, particularly among the Germanic and French nobility. The name was borne by several saints and kings, including Saint Richarius of England and King Richard the Lionheart of England.
